data.name: Discerning Pattern
data.description: When fighting a creature that is not one of your active enemy types, you may attempt to identify that creature with a Knowledge check appropriate to the creature's type as a swift action; if successful, you may treat the creature as if it was one of your active enemy types until the target is dead or unconscious or combat ends.  Whether or not discerning pattern is successful, the creature cannot be the target of this ability for 24 hours.
